body:
## MCP fleet multi-instance design + P-22/P-23 safe-subset implementation

**Scope disclosure (per supervisor disposition)**: this branch is **not design-only**. It contains:
1. The governing design + evidence base (`claudedocs/mcp-fleet-multi-instance-{design,evidence}-2026-07-28.md`), **ACCEPTED with supervisor rulings D1–D4 applied** (design §10), plus the supervisor **repair pass** (commit edb265c963).
2. **P-22 safe subset (implementation)**: 14 legacy fleet launch scripts / compose overlays deleted (2,521 deleted lines are intentional — see label); runtime callers repaired (`dopemux mcp up` no longer shells out to a deleted script; `provision.py` stack sentinel swapped); CI guard test `tests/mcp/test_no_legacy_fleet_start_paths.py` added.
3. **P-23 safe subset (docs)**: AGENTS.md §12.6 sharing-class table, `.claude/claude.md` fleet rules, stale pre-#1052 catch-22 workaround removed, lettered A–E model deprecation-bannered, ~40 reader-facing docs corrected (`:8000` shadow twin vs `:7890` MCP surface, `registry.yaml` deprecation).
4. **M10: attempted then REVERTED** (supervisor repair 3): the `.vibe/config.toml` repoint to `127.0.0.1:7890` was reverted because that port is currently held by the dNh_CRM task-orchestrator and no identity-aware switch mechanism exists yet — a static URL would silently route this repo's workflow calls into another project. A warning comment now guards the entry; M10 is blocked until P-24 or a fail-closed identity-verifying wrapper.

### Supervisor rulings baked into the design (2026-07-28)
- **D1**: Kotlin TO end-state = **project-scoped leased-port instances** (new ADR required, packet P-24); `multi_project_singleton` NOT authorized; `switch-project` transitional only. Corrected record: PR #1086 was closed for bundling an unapproved authority change — governance rejection, not technical proof.
- **D2**: python `:8000` service will be **renamed** (candidate `dopemux-workflow-api`), not retired — DopeconBridge and workflow surfaces depend on it (rewritten M11).
- **D3**: ConPort end-state = **project-scoped**, never host-singleton; CRS v2/P-18 rewritten around a fixed project tenant with the wall enforced in storage.
- **D4**: redis-events REQUIRED target = **project-scoped**; P-21 elevated to P0. **OBSERVED runtime today remains an unsafe host singleton** — no P-21 implementation is in this branch; docs state observed-vs-required explicitly (supervisor repair 1).

### Migration status
`GO_M0_ONLY` — M0 snapshots executed to `~/.dopemux/backup/` (containers, volumes, lease registry, pal container inspects). M0 status per supervisor: CLAIMED_COMPLETE (snapshots are operator-local, not independently verified). **M3 is BLOCKED with rollback UNKNOWN** (supervisor repair 2): its previously stated rollback source (`/private/tmp/pal-model-refresh` compose) no longer exists; a bounded recreation-proof packet (pinned `ensure-pal.sh` revision, image digest, mounts/env, shadow-name recreation, health + Codex `docker exec` verification) is required first. M1–M5 remain blocked pending P-07/P-10 implementation.

### Validation
- PASS: `tests/mcp/` + CLI startup + health-probe suites (72 tests at head edb265c963); removal commit additionally validated against 168 tests incl. unit/arch suites; guard test passes.
- NOT_RUN: full repo suite; any blocked migration step.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

### Independent audit (supervisor-required, head edb265c963)
**PASS_WITH_RISKS** (non-blocking) via route #2 Claude Code CLI/Sonnet (route #1 AGY timed out; recorded in proof provenance). Signed local attestation: `proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-1150/` (commit a8838e2a62, proof-only delta on the audited head).

**Disclosed P-22 gaps found by the audit** (the guard test under-delivers on its docstring claim; these are follow-up packets, NOT fixed here to preserve audit head-binding):
- Guard regex misses `docker compose -p <project> … up` — `scripts/start.sh:81` and `scripts/compose_nuke.sh:35` remain live un-allowlisted fleet-start paths.
- `dopemux init`'s default MCP startup (`src/dopemux/cli.py` `_start_mcp_servers_with_progress`) builds a compose invocation in Python and bypasses `dopemux mcp` — structurally invisible to a regex guard.
- `scripts/deploy/setup/install-mcp-servers.sh:128` now silently no-ops its Docker-MCP install step (calls a deleted script behind an existence check).
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` still presents `services/registry.yaml` as live authority; `docs/02-how-to/operations/pm-plane-runtime-recovery.md` still "Recommends" raw compose starts a few lines below this PR's own scope note.

commits.messageBody:
Removes the duplicate/dead MCP fleet start scripts and legacy compose
overlays identified by claudedocs/mcp-legacy-launch-path-worklist-2026-07-28.md,
per the P-22 packet in claudedocs/mcp-fleet-multi-instance-design-2026-07-28.md §9.

Deleted (14 files covering all 15 worklist paths — docker/mcp-servers/ is a
git-tracked symlink to docker/mcp-servers-source/, so the two worklist
entries for start-all-mcp-servers.sh under those paths are the same file):
- scripts/start-all-mcp-servers.sh
- scripts/manage-mcp-servers.sh, scripts/mcp/manage-mcp-servers.sh
- scripts/install-docker-mcp-servers.sh
- scripts/deploy/deployment/{start-all,start-mcp-servers,stack_up_all}.sh
- scripts/memory/start-memory-stack.sh
- scripts/setup.sh
- compose/legacy/{conport-kg,leantime-overlay}-docker-compose.yml
- docker/mcp-servers-source/{start-all-mcp-servers,start-profile,setup-task-orchestrator}.sh

Runtime fixes required before these could safely go (discovered by tracing
actual callers, not just grepping filenames):
- src/dopemux/mcp/provision.py: MCPProvisioner used "start-all-mcp-servers.sh"
  as its "is this a valid MCP stack" sentinel across every candidate source
  (project local/source/vendor/cache/package template). Deleting the script
  without changing this would have made `ensure_stack_present()` unlink the
  docker/mcp-servers symlink and then raise, breaking `dopemux init`'s
  MCP-provisioning flow. Swapped the sentinel to README.md, which ships with
  every copy of the vendored tree and isn't a launch path.
- src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py: `dopemux mcp up` (no --repo) shelled
  out to scripts/start-all-mcp-servers.sh directly for the --all/default
  case. Replaced with the same docker-compose-service-list approach `mcp
  down` already uses (DEFAULT_MCP_SERVICES ∩ compose services), so `dopemux
  mcp up --all` — the command INSTALL.md now documents as canonical — no
  longer depends on a script that doesn't exist.
- .claude/hooks/mcp_health_probe.py: generic remediation suggestion changed
  from `docker compose up -d {name}` to `dopemux mcp up --services {name}`.
- .vibe/config.toml: task-orchestrator entry repointed from the FastAPI
  shadow-twin at :8000 to the canonical Kotlin jar singleton at
  127.0.0.1:7890/mcp (streamable HTTP), per design migration step M10.

Reference updates: INSTALL.md (drops the raw-script alternative at
~L1157, extends the compose-deprecation note to cover the removed
compose/legacy/ files), scripts/README.md, docs/03-reference/services/
server-registry{,-2}.md and the vendored SERVER_REGISTRY.md copy (Quick
Reference now points at `dopemux mcp up --all`), and
scripts/deploy/setup/install-mcp-servers.sh's closing hints.

Added tests/mcp/test_no_legacy_fleet_start_paths.py: a CI guard that walks
git-tracked executable files (*.sh/*.py/*.ps1/Makefile — prose in docs/JSON
can't launch anything) for `docker compose up` / `docker-compose up` and
fails on any hit outside an explicitly justified allowlist. The sweep
surfaced two pre-existing, out-of-worklist direct-compose paths (Makefile's
pm-up/webhook_receiver targets, docker/leantime/configure_bridge.sh, and an
unscoped scripts/deploy/setup/setup_dopemux.sh with no live caller) that are
allowlisted with a note flagging them for a follow-up packet rather than
rewritten here, to keep this change to the safe subset.

Updated tests/mcp/test_provision.py, tests/test_cli_mcp_startup.py, and
tests/test_mcp_health_probe.py for the sentinel/suggestion-string changes
above.

Supervisor decision: GO with mandatory design corrections
(GO_DRAFT_PR / GO_M0_ONLY / BLOCK_M1_M5_PENDING_PREREQUISITES).

- D1 (10.1): Kotlin TO end-state = project-scoped leased-port instances
  (one jar per project, new ADR required, packet P-24). Corrects the
  'revert reason UNKNOWN' claim: PR #1086 was closed for bundling an
  unapproved authority change - governance rejection, not technical
  proof. multi_project_singleton stays NOT authorized; switch-project
  is transitional only.
- D2 (10.2): python :8000 service is RENAMED (candidate
  dopemux-workflow-api), not retired - DopeconBridge and workflow/MCP
  surfaces depend on it; M11 rewritten as bounded rename packet.
- D3 (10.3): ConPort end-state = project-scoped, never host-singleton;
  P-18/CRS v2 rewritten around a fixed project tenant with the wall in
  storage; P-19 flip target corrected.
- D4 (10.4): redis-events project-scoped NOW; P-21 elevated to P0 -
  dope-memory promotes activity.events.v1 into work_log_entries via a
  global consumer group, refuting the events-are-advisory premise.
- Migration section records M0-only authorization; M10 marked executed.
- AGENTS.md 12.6, .claude/claude.md, and 12 reader-facing docs updated
  from 'pending retirement' to 'pending rename' and corrected end-states.

Supervisor verdict on PR #1150: NEEDS_REPAIR_BEFORE_READY. Three repairs:

1. redis-events documentation no longer claims project-scoped as 'class
   today'. AGENTS.md 12.6, .claude/claude.md, and design 1.2/5.1 now state
   OBSERVED runtime = host singleton (unsafe/noncompliant for
   multi-project), REQUIRED immediate target = project-scoped, gate =
   P-21 implementation + isolation validation. The ruling changed the
   authorized target, not the running container.

2. Design M3 rewritten: BLOCKED with rollback UNKNOWN. M0 established
   /private/tmp/pal-model-refresh no longer contains its compose file, so
   the previously stated rollback was impossible. M3 stays blocked until
   a bounded packet proves deterministic recreation (pinned ensure-pal.sh
   revision, image digest, mounts/volumes/command/redacted env,
   shadow-name recreation, health + Codex docker exec verification).

3. .vibe/config.toml task-orchestrator entry REVERTED to :8000. Port 7890
   is currently held by the dNh_CRM jar and switch-project does not exist
   yet, so the static repoint could silently route Dopemux workflow calls
   into another project while looking healthy. A warning comment now
   guards the entry; design M10 is BLOCKED until P-24 or a fail-closed
   identity-verifying wrapper exists.

Focused suites: 72 passed.
